panels.description: difference between current block and last block update

targets.rawSql:
SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), NULLIF(ck.label, ''), LEFT(h.hotkey, 8) || '...') AS validator, b.number - mm.last_update AS " ", b.timestamp AS time
FROM metagraph_neuron n
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey h ON h.id = n.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_coldkey ck ON ck.id = h.coldkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot ns ON ns.neuron_id = n.id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = ns.block_id AND ns.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND ns.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics mm ON mm.snapshot_id = ns.id AND mm.mech_id = ${mech_id}
WHERE n.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND ns.is_validator = true AND h.hotkey = '${validator}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
ORDER BY ns.total_stake DESC

panels.title: Balance of collateral contract owner ${validator} of sn${subnet}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT c.amount AS " ", b.timestamp AS time, mh.hotkey AS miner
FROM metagraph_neuron vn
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey vh ON vh.id = vn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_collateral c ON c.target_neuron_id = vn.id AND c.amount > 0
  JOIN metagraph_neuron mn ON mn.id = c.source_neuron_id
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey mh ON mh.id = mn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = c.block_id AND c.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND c.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
WHERE vn.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND vh.hotkey = '${validator}'
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'

panels.title: Collateral deposits from miners to ${validator} on sn${subnet}

targets.rawSql:
SELECT (w.weight / NULLIF(src_mm.weights_sum, 0)) AS " ", b.timestamp AS time, mh.hotkey AS miner
FROM metagraph_neuron vn
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey vh ON vh.id = vn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_weight w ON w.source_neuron_id = vn.id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron_snapshot src_ns ON src_ns.neuron_id = w.source_neuron_id AND src_ns.block_id = w.block_id
  JOIN metagraph_mechanism_metrics src_mm ON src_mm.snapshot_id = src_ns.id AND src_mm.mech_id = w.mech_id
  JOIN metagraph_neuron mn ON mn.id = w.target_neuron_id
  JOIN metagraph_hotkey mh ON mh.id = mn.hotkey_id
  JOIN metagraph_block b ON b.number = w.block_id AND w.block_id >= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp >= '${__from:date}' ORDER BY timestamp LIMIT 1) AND w.block_id <= (SELECT number FROM metagraph_block WHERE timestamp <= '${__to:date}' ORDER BY timestamp DESC LIMIT 1)
WHERE vn.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND vh.hotkey = '${validator}'
  AND mn.subnet_id = ${subnet} AND w.mech_id = ${mech_id}
  AND w.weight > 0 AND src_mm.weights_sum != 0
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'

  TO_CHAR(MAX(ns.total_stake / 1e9), 'fm00000000'), '.',
  TO_CHAR(MAX(ns.block_id), 'fm00000000'), '----',
  COALESCE(NULLIF(h.label, ''), CONCAT(h.hotkey, ' @ ', MAX(ns.total_stake / 1e9))), '----',

  AND ns.is_validator = true
  AND b.timestamp BETWEEN '${__from:date}' AND '${__to:date}'
GROUP BY h.hotkey, h.label
